experiment.name: AgentFace feedback-loop optimization
experiment.purpose: Keep the SDXL base model and diffusion settings fixed, score each output, and use a bounded batch feedback update to change only the beautification profile.
experiment.base_prompt: natural face retouching, clean healthy skin, preserve identity, preserve facial geometry, preserve hair, accessories, expression and background, photorealistic
experiment.negative_prompt: different person, altered identity, deformed face, extra eyes, extra mouth, blurry, cartoon, plastic skin, waxy skin, excessive whitening
experiment.prompt_parameter_encoding: semantic strength label plus compact continuous 0-to-5 strength for each learnable beautification parameter
